items.result: The main DA09 QUST override has ENAM=LEVL and a schema-decoded Start Game Enabled bit that is clear. The Gem alias callback requests stage 100 when Player receives the Gem; the statue alias callback requests stage 200 when Player has it. The separate DA09ChangeLocation CLOC child requires a DA09 stage-0 condition and its fragment places the Gem alias into a boss-container alias; the inspected callback has no main DA09 Start/SetStage call. The Update fix-up fragment only relocates the Gem alias under stage/location conditions. None of DA09's 20 DIALs or 25 INFO children has a function-80/GetLevel CTDA; the 31,465-record INFO screen has 40 GetLevel conditions in other topics. The five-master raw-byte screen found no direct Beacon REFR/LVLI reference; its candidates include a QA container and quest aliases. These are bounded source observations; they do not establish stopped event-scoped SetStage behavior on Steam or level-one Beacon availability.
